 Karvy Customer: For activating your account click here . Jio Platforms IPO Day 2: GMP Trend and Subscription Status
 22 Oct 2026 , 11:14 AM
 As of 11:02 AM on October 22, 2026, the Jio Platforms IPO was subscribed 3.48 times, with strong demand from qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) and the retail investor category crossing full subscription. The grey market premium (GMP) stood at ₹247 per share, indicating an estimated listing price of ₹1,366 against the upper price band of ₹1,119.
 Key Pointers 
 Overall subscription reaches 3.48x: The IPO received bids for 19.75 crore shares against the shares offered across investor categories, according to the supplied subscription data.
 QIB subscription leads at 9.42x: The qualified institutional buyer category recorded the highest subscription, reflecting substantial institutional demand.
 Retail portion crosses 1x: The retail individual investor (RII) category was subscribed 1.03 times.
 NII portion subscribed 2.34x: The non-institutional investor category recorded 2.34 times subscription, with small NII investors at 2.06x and big NII investors at 2.48x.
 Employee and shareholder categories: The employee portion was subscribed 1.61 times, while the shareholder category recorded 2.06 times subscription.
 GMP at ₹247: The latest grey market premium at 10:37 AM on October 22 indicated a premium of 22.07% over the upper issue price of ₹1,119.
 Estimated listing price of ₹1,366: Based on the latest GMP, the implied listing price was ₹1,366 per share. This is an indicative estimate based on unofficial grey market activity and does not guarantee the actual listing price.
 GMP remains elevated: The premium increased from ₹206 on October 14 to ₹247 on October 22, after touching ₹273 on October 20.
